input_bev: Captured current depth warped to estimated anchor by causal odometry only; retain exact source and odom stamps
target_bev: Captured future depth, SE2 warp to true ego anchor; simulator ego pose is LABEL ONLY
wm_window_eligibility: Moving capture accepted, all3target frames temporally supported and observed cells nonempty, causal input BEV valid, original history complete per legacy masks; no semantic/persona prerequisite
action_condition: Explicit separate accessor for executed future command sequence; not a future sensor input or counterfactual rollout
episode_end: Physical task goal reached terminates; time-limit/controller stop truncates; RL reward/contact semantics not validated
raw_authority: Closed original MCAP; auxiliary NPY may miss warmup frames; compare all exported depth against MCAP
test_policy: Whole seed49 family held for future WM evaluation; this collection stage runs integrity/label QA only, no WM fitting, model evaluation or test preview
recovery: No overwrites; preserve failures; capture and normalization/target export have separate frozen source manifests
